plan.objective: Reconstruct the corrupted exact epoch-4 optimizer state without duplicating Comet data, then continue from step 2000 to 40000 in the original Comet experiment.

failure.location: transition from completed step-2000 validation/checkpoint to epoch 5
failure.checkpoint_load_error: PytorchStreamReader failed reading zip archive: failed finding central directory

recovery.phase_1: Replay steps 0-2000 through the original Comet initialization path with event emission suppressed and validation disabled, producing an atomic full epoch-4 checkpoint.
recovery.phase_2: Resume the original Comet experiment from the replayed checkpoint and continue through 40000 with full-96 validation every 2000 steps.
recovery.checkpoint_coordination_fix: All ranks wait before and after rank-0-only logging/checkpoint writes.
recovery.checkpoint_write_fix: Write to a same-directory temporary file and atomically replace the final checkpoint.
recovery.fresh_container_cache_fix: Opt-in rank-serialized model initialization lets rank 0 populate the model cache before rank 1 constructs the identical model; this prevents the intermittent concurrent 891 MB artifact download/cache race.
recovery.replay_comet_isolation: CometMLWriter suppress_events keeps the original writer initialization/RNG path while withholding duplicate metrics, images, tables, and assets.

unchanged_controls.validation: 96 fixed images at step 0 and every 2000 optimizer steps
